label: CoinPaprika
terms_note: Free plan, no key (api.coinpaprika.com). HTML docs. Live 2026-10-01: the documented path /v1/search answers 301 to /v1/search/ (followed, same host); response headers RateLimit-Limit: 20000 (calls per month on the free plan). Historical OHLCV older than about 24 hours answers 402 'not allowed in this plan'. An unknown coin id on ohlcv answers 200 [] (no error).

search_symbols.note: Coins and tokens matching the query; symbol is CoinPaprika's coin id (btc-bitcoin), the ticker symbol is in raw.symbol. The API returns at most `limit` matches and has no paging, so there is no next page.

not_offered.me: The free API has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_candles: GET /coins/{coin_id}/ohlcv/historical answers 402 'Getting historical OHLCV data before <yesterday> is not allowed in this plan' on the free plan (live 2026-10-01); the latest-day endpoints return one candle, not a series.
not_offered.get_series: No named macro/indicator series in this API.
not_offered.get_news: Events per coin exist (/coins/{id}/events) but there is no headline search; not mapped.
